limitation: This is a single-agent role-separated review. The user approved only a deterministic fixture gate; no actual Evidence promotion, Lead/Human approval, persistence, source read, model, tool, network or downstream consumption is authorized.

user_confirmation.confirmation_note: Approval explicitly requires fixture_only/unpromoted inputs, non-authoritative decision flags, hard-rule non-overridable rejection, and an M6.6 audit return before M6.7.

checks: The schema does not permit a bare accepted decision.
Every decision has deterministic_fixture_only scope and all runtime/citation/judgment/persistence flags false.
Hard failures use rejection or typed-gap states only.
Request, bundle, parser candidate, normalized fact and numeric trace ids/digests are rechecked.
Entity, period, unit, scale, authority, trace and forbidden-substitution rules are hard gates.
Conflicting table candidates cannot be silently selected.
Semantic output is an inert classification_suggestion.
Hard rejection cannot be overridden by semantic suggestion, Lead or fixture reviewer.
Lead/Human state is approval_required_not_executed; no receipt can be fabricated.
Writer and DomainJudgment consumption guards fail closed.
M6.7 cannot treat a fixture gate decision as formal evidence.
No context injection or promotion persistence is exposed.
Only fixture-only, unpromoted inputs are accepted.
All tests remain execution-free and deterministic.
No M5 admission/budget, tool, provider, network, store write, Case or legacy authority mutation occurs.
